title: The Locked Apartment
intro: You wake up with a mild headache. Looking around, you realize you are inside a small, unfamiliar apartment. The main exit door is locked solid. You need to investigate your surroundings, find the key, and escape.
ending: *** MISSION COMPLETE! You successfully escaped the apartment! ***

living_room.name: Living Room
living_room.description: A dusty living room with a worn-out couch, a wooden table, and a locked exit door. A wooden drawer sits in the corner. A doorway to the east leads to the Bedroom.

bedroom.name: Bedroom
bedroom.description: A quiet, small bedroom with a single bed and a desk. On the desk, you see a shiny key. A doorway to the west leads back to the Living Room.

drawer.name: Wooden Drawer
drawer.description: An empty drawer, but written on the bottom is a scribble: 'Look carefully at the bedroom desk!'

desk.name: Desk
desk.description: A wooden study desk. It has a smooth surface. There is nothing else of interest here.

exit_door.name: Exit Door
exit_door.description: A solid steel-reinforced door. The lock is heavy and requires a brass key to open.

brass_key.name: Brass Key
brass_key.description: A heavy, shiny brass key. It looks like it could unlock the apartment exit.

exit_puzzle.successResponse: You insert the Brass Key into the lock. With a satisfying click, the exit door swings open! You are free!
exit_puzzle.failureResponse: The key doesn't fit or something is missing.

objectives.text: Find the key in the bedroom
Unlock the exit door and escape the apartment
